dct_description_sm:
Data from greenhouse experiment conducted in summer of 2022, manipulating species richness and water regime. The dataset contains biomass production and functional trait measurements, and net biodiversity effects computations.
The dataset also contains two sets of scanned images:
LEAF_SCAN: High-resolution scans of leaves used for functional trait measurements. Each image is species-specific and linked to an individual plant. File names include the unique identifier of the experimental unit, the initial of the species, and the individual plant number from which the leaves were collected.
ROOT_SCAN: Scanned images of roots for functional trait measurements. Each image corresponds to a specific root sample. File names include the unique identifier of the experimental unit and the root sample number.
dct_title_s: Replication Data for: Flooding stress influences productivity and modulates biodiversity effects in experimental grassland communities, shaping biodiversity-productivity relationships.
